_meta.purpose: Competitor persona + innovative/traditional axis.  Cognitive-stance axis (new-approach vs proven-method).  Competitor is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.00, n=4).  Trait poles ask near-identical 'best approach to X' prompts; the axis modulates the answer's lean toward novelty or established practice.  Question mix: 5 innovative-trait approach-prompts + 4 traditional-trait same-shape prompts + 2 competitor-role probes + 1 extraction power + 2 hand-written.
